title: NutriScan AI Ingredient Screening Dictionary
important_note: This is a screening vocabulary, not a toxic-substance list. Ingredient presence alone does not establish harm. Additive permissions and limits depend on jurisdiction, food category and concentration. Contaminants such as heavy metals and mycotoxins require laboratory testing and cannot be detected from a barcode ingredient list. Verify against current FSSAI/Codex rules and package labels.
